text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp ends in the blink of an
eye.
Bamboo Memory was so happy it
started that she
was brought to tears.
And now...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gah! I just can't believe summer camp is
really
over! I'm stunned!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But still! I can't be hung up on it forever!
Isn't that
right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes is just around the
corner!
OHHH! I'm getting all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Would it be okay if I run
back to the
academy?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're right! Let's take the bus!
choice_data_list: 風紀を守ってバスで帰ろうッ！
choice_data_list_en: Let's uphold discipline and take the bus back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes is almost here!
Bamboo
Memory suppresses the urge to
show off the
results of her summer camp
training and heads
home by bus!
